strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Band Touch with SMI and MACD Angle
strategy_roster.entry_long: close <= bb_lower(close,20,2) and rsi(close,14) > 0 and rsi(close,14) < 60 and roc(macd(close,12,26),1) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2), the upper-band exit, and the documented long-only rule are retained. Positive RSI(14) below 60 and a rising MACD(12,26) are proxies for the unavailable SMI and MACD angle thresholds; no stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Fearzone Panel
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,200) and close <= bb_lower(close,200,2) and low <= donchian_low_prev(low,22) and (roc(close,10) < -0.1 or rsi(close,30) < 30)
strategy_roster.notes: MA(200), Bollinger(200), the 22-bar lookback, and negative ROC(10) or RSI(30)<30 panic proxies are retained. FZ1/FZ2 and ricochet-zone internals are not defined in the DSL, so lower-band and prior-low conditions proxy their simultaneous activation; the documented exit is the MA(200) loss.

strategy_roster.name: Disturbed
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy opens simultaneous long and short hedge orders and manages them by spread levels, which this long-only OHLCV DSL cannot represent. A false positive-price guard avoids fabricating a one-sided entry; the unreachable exit preserves the externally managed hedge.

strategy_roster.name: CCI COMA
strategy_roster.entry_long: zscore(close,20) > 0 and rsi(close,14) > 50 and close > open and sma(close,20) > sma(close,50)
strategy_roster.exit_long: zscore(close,20) < 0 or rsi(close,14) < 50 or close < open or sma(close,20) < sma(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: CCI and multi-timeframe monitoring are unavailable; positive 20-bar z-score, RSI(14)>50, a bullish candle, and SMA(20)>SMA(50) are explicit current-timeframe fallbacks. The opposite conditions form the long exit; no stop or target is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Breakout DC2008
strategy_roster.notes: The documented Close-applied Bollinger(80,3) downside stretch is translated with the required two-argument bb_mid(close,80) and the high-below-middle condition. Middle-band reversion is a long-exit proxy because no explicit exit is supplied; the short side and non-negative-profit reversal filter are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Parabolic SAR Cross
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR is unavailable, so a close crossing above and below EMA(20) proxies bullish and bearish SAR flips; EMA(20) is an explicit fallback because no acceleration, maximum, or lookback defaults are supplied. Point-based stop, target, trailing, volume, and short-side handling are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: ABE BE RSI
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close - open > sma(close - open,5) and close > sma(close,5) and rsi(close,11) < 40
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(11) thresholds 40/60 and exit levels 30/70 are documented. A bullish candle with a body above its 5-bar average and close above SMA(5) is a proxy for the required two-candle engulfing; the opposing RSI cross exits, while the short side and price-step protection are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: The Enchantress
strategy_roster.notes: The ten-bucket history, virtual order scoring, and top-performing seven-candle pattern state are not expressible in the stateless DSL. Positive seven-bar ROC with a bullish candle is the long pattern proxy, with the opposite condition as exit; 19/60-pip real targets and 25/55-pip virtual levels are not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Mean Reversion Donchian
strategy_roster.notes: A new low below the prior 200-bar Donchian low is the documented long entry, and the prior-range midpoint is the documented target. The mirrored high entry, short side, and risk-based position sizing are omitted; RiskPercent=1% is not a stop distance.

strategy_roster.name: SMC Hilo MaxMin Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The prior-candle high is the long buy-stop trigger, represented by high above the prior one-bar Donchian high; a prior-low break is a range-failure exit proxy. The terminal-hour straddle, canceled opposite order, 500/30-pip target-stop, 30-pip trail, and pending-order padding are not representable as percentage fields.
